title: ClearPath Loyalty Points on Network and Server Order Cancellation Fees
content:
Loyalty points come off the infrastructure fee percentage, the fee percentage charged on a Hardware Procurement Network Equipment Order or Server & Storage Build Order cancelled after its purchase order, by the client's ClearPath tenure: the whole months from the go-live date of its active ClearPath Managed IT Services agreement to the day the cancellation is recorded, a month completing only once the day of the month reaches the go-live date's day number.

| ClearPath tenure on the cancellation day | Points off |
|---|---|
| at least 48 whole months | 1.5 |
| at least 24 and fewer than 48 whole months | 0.5 |
| fewer than 24 whole months | none |
| no active ClearPath agreement | none |

**Counting, worked (hypothetical dates).** For an agreement that went live on 15 June of one year, a cancellation recorded on 14 June two years later finds 23 whole months, and no points; one recorded on 15 June two years later finds 24 whole months, and 0.5 points. On 15 June four years after go-live the tenure reaches 48 whole months, and 1.5 points come off.
